action.prompt: Using the memkernel MCP server: call recall(query="session checkpoint", checkpoint_only=true, top_k=3) and recall(query="<current task>", tier="long_term", top_k=8). If the project has a wiki (MEMKERNEL_WIKI_DIR), read its index.md. Summarise what is relevant in three lines, then continue with the user's request.

Before finishing: if this turn produced a decision, convention, fact or procedure that holds beyond this session, retain it in memkernel with that type (one idea per memory; use supersedes=<old ref_id> when it replaces an earlier one). If the plan or task state changed, retain(type="task", content="Goal: ... Next: ... Open: ..."). Do nothing if there is nothing worth keeping.

Write a session checkpoint to memkernel: retain(content="SESSION CHECKPOINT
Done: ...
Current: ...
Next: ...
Open: ...", type="episode", checkpoint=true, importance=0.8), then call consolidate() and promote(ref_id=..., type=..., content=...) for each candidate worth keeping as a fact, decision, convention or procedure.
